configuration: Early 1941 Home Fleet exterior, before December AA refit; 1940 standard mean-draft datum
authoringBoundary: Historical drawings and photographs inform manual original authoring. GameModels3D geometry is restricted to an isolated raster renderer. Production uses the versioned blueprint/catalog and original Python; no game offsets, attachment transforms, UVs, textures or geometry are authoring inputs.

frameRegistration.note: Review sections use metres from the overall stern. Original body-plan ordinate no.1 is provisionally registered at Blender X=112 m, 35 ft spacing. These are distinct station systems.

coordinates.loadState: 29 ft 1940 standard mean draft; not battle-day load/trim

dimensions.note: Original manually read section samples, interpolated to 228 longitudinal stations. Rounded bilges, fine flared forebody and rising stern; design-versus-as-fitted and station-origin uncertainty remain.
Distinct tower trunk, projecting admiral/navigation cabins, signal wings and small service galleries replace repeated nested prisms.

Revision 4 measures local raster proportions: longer main gunhouses, lower narrower roofs, aft quad crown, common Mk VII exposed barrel geometry and enlarged B barbette. RN plates 2/62 and IWM photographs guide form. See reports/visual-iteration-04/measurements.json for source disagreement and remaining uncertainty. Stable muzzle and joint IDs retained.
Open funnel jackets, searchlight galleries, rigging, boats, Carley floats, stairways, catapult/crane lattice and deck services are original interpreted details.
Retained machinery IDs and positions. Five room envelopes reduced to fit the revised hull; flood spaces regenerated, protection clipped and hydrostatics recalibrated. Gameplay approximations remain.

historicalRegistration.method: Two independent original drawings assembled at one common metric scale. Profile unchanged, registered by LOA endpoints and keel. Upper deck uniformly resized once from its own complete LOA endpoints, then translated; no anisotropic stretching, skew correction or component fitting.
historicalRegistration.limits: The port overlay mirrors the same starboard profile and does not certify side-specific fittings. Top drawing 1280 px; scale uncertainty larger than full-resolution profile. Original files are retained beside this derived presentation sheet.

review.title: HMS King George V · early 1941
review.intro: Original reconstruction refined against Vickers schematics, dated photographs and GameModels3D raster views. Inspect the actual exported ship with matched cameras, retained originals and explicit source uncertainty.
review.historicalCredit: Royal Museums Greenwich / National Maritime Museum; Vickers-Armstrongs original drawings
review.historicalLabel: Vickers 1941 drawings · common metric scale / keel datum
review.limits: Body-plan sections are manual interpretations of a 1937/38 design drawing, not certified as-built offsets. Gunhouse, fitting dimensions and paint remain approximate. Game stock hull retains some later radar/light-AA details excluded from the 1941 reconstruction. CPU gunhouse armor retains a complete simplified face envelope behind the visible recessed ports.
